theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M E W : Set (Euclid P)) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (Φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), IsOpen V → IsOpen W → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → InjOn ψ V → ψ '' V = W ∩ M → (∀ K ⊆ W, IsCompact K → IsCompact (V ∩ ψ ⁻¹' K)) → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → MeasurableSet E → E ⊆ W ∩ M → ContDiff ℝ 1 Φ → InjOn Φ E → (∀ x ∈ E, Injective (fderiv ℝ Φ x)) → μHE[m] (Φ '' E) = ∫⁻ x in E, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt ((((fderiv ℝ Φ x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL).adjoint ∘L ((fderiv ℝ Φ x).comp (Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).subtypeL)).det)) ∂μHE[m]
